استعذي (form X)
# اُسْتُعْذِيَ (ustuʕḏiya) /us.tuʕ.ði.ja/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# اِسْتَعْذِي (istaʕḏī) /is.taʕ.ðiː/: second-person feminine singular imperative of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
